question: 区分全局阻尼与按样本重分配，再对照替代信号。

matching.kind: approximate prespecified scale match, not trajectory/gradient-norm equality
verify: controller/ranking unchanged; free-running DSR dose can differ

blockers: No entropy_only CLI branch exists. Implement binary entropy weighting with same regional loss/scale and same disagreement DSR sensor. Runtime guard currently accepts only anchor_only/uniform_recap; extend deliberately.

implementation_spec.signal: normalized entropy = H(softmax(logits)) / log(C), detached pre-update
implementation_spec.selection: top-k by normalized entropy within each batch; stable sample-index tie break
implementation_spec.controller: disagreement as reference; do not feed entropy mask to DSR
implementation_spec.expansion: run2 and run3 if pilot is directionally clear; pilot alone never satisfies 3/3 rule

entropy_comparison.interpretation: descriptively similar; does not establish formal equivalence or anchor specificity

rules.caveat: A free-running controller can change recovery trajectory when the loss changes; this is a system-level weighting comparison, not a matched-dose causal isolation.
